payload.input:
In app.ini, replace the two consecutive lines
host=localhost
port=8080
with these two lines
host=0.0.0.0
port=9090
Do it as one targeted edit of that two-line block with your file edit tool; do not rewrite the whole file and do not touch any other line.

rawInput.command: cd /workspace/project && ls -l app.ini 2>&1; echo "--- od ---"; od -c app.ini 2>&1; echo "--- cat -A ---"; cat -A app.ini 2>&1
